plan: Hold accepted state in a single authoritative `session` dict with exactly the four contract keys, rebuilt from one `_initial_session()` factory for construction, begin, and abandon.

Build every screen through one `_screen(prompt, messages)` helper that emits exactly prompt/messages/choices and attaches fresh appointment-choice copies (input order) exactly when the prompt is `Choose appointment`.
Derive the next unmet prompt in `_current_prompt()` from session state and reuse it for accepted corrections and as the prompt of error screens.

Dispatch `handle(action)` by `type` to per-action methods that validate all preconditions and payload fields before mutating session, so invalid or malformed actions return an `Error:`-prefixed screen without raising or corrupting data.

Inject `action_source`/`screen_sink` as duck-typed collaborators (`read_action()`/`display(screen)`) replaceable by stdlib unittest fakes; `run_once()` raises RuntimeError before touching either if one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, displays the screen exactly once, and returns that same screen object.
Copy appointments at construction into `{id, label}` records and re-copy per screen so output is deterministic and immune to external mutation.
mechanisms: authoritative session dictionary with factory-based reset
single screen-builder helper with prompt-conditioned choice attachment
next-unmet-prompt derivation reused for corrections and error screens
validate-then-mutate action dispatch with Error:-prefixed non-raising failure screens
injected duck-typed action source and screen sink ports with RuntimeError guard in run_once
defensive copying of appointment data at construction and per screen
